name: 🥚 Veggie & Cheese Omelets
tagline: One big skillet omelet you slice into wedges: no flipping four separate omelets.

steps.text: Oven on to broil. Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a 10–12 inch oven-safe nonstick skillet over medium. Cook the pepper until soft.
Add spinach and stir until it wilts.
Pour in the eggs. Cook without stirring, lifting the edges so raw egg runs under.
When the top is almost set, scatter the cheese and slide under the broiler until puffed and golden.
Slide out, cut into wedges and serve with English muffins.

chef_tip: Finish under the broiler: the top sets fluffy and the cheese bubbles without anyone flipping anything.
leftovers: Wedges keep 3 days; reheat 30 seconds or eat cold on an English muffin.
swaps: Jack or mozzarella instead of cheddar
